question: Of the units mentioned in the options, which one is the largest as compared to the others?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tera**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Of the units mentioned in the options, Tera is the largest as compared to the others**__.
 
• A computer processor is made up of multiple decisive circuits, each one of which may be either OFF or ON.
 
• These two states in terms of memory are represented by a 0 or 1.
 __
 
• In order to count higher than 1, such bits (BInary digiTS) are suspended together.
 
• A group of eight bits is known as a byte.
 
• 1 byte can represent numbers between zero (00000000) and 255 (11111111), or 28 = 256 distinct positions. Of course, these bytes may also be combined to represent larger numbers.
 
 
 
• **Types of various Units of Memory based on size**:
 
 
• Byte
 
• KiloByte
 
• MegaByte
 
• GigaByte
 
• TeraByte
 
• Peta Byte
 
• Exa Byte
 
• Zetta Byte
 
• Yotta Byte
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **memory of a Computer** is any physical device that is capable of storing information whether it is large or small and stores it temporarily or permanently.

 
 
• For example, Random Access Memory (RAM), is a type of volatile memory that stores information for a short interval of time, on an integrated circuit used by the operating system. 
 
• Memory can be either **volatile or non-volatile**.
 
• Volatile memory is a type of memory that loses its contents when the computer or hardware device is switched off.
